hero.tagline: I build software in Rust, Go and on the blockchain — from peer-to-peer networks and smart contracts to backend infrastructure, with TypeScript and AI when the job calls for them.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A bit about who I am and what I do.
about.p1: I'm a software engineer focused on Rust, Go and blockchain. I build backend infrastructure, peer-to-peer networking and smart-contract systems, both as open-source tools and in production. I also work with TypeScript and build AI agents.
about.p2: I care about performance, correctness and clean architecture, and about tools that make hard problems feel simple. When I find a recurring pain point, I tend to turn it into a library.
focus: Backend services & infrastructure in Rust and Go
